speaker.jigoku_unit: Destiny Gundam (デスティニーガンダム)
speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Self-intro 'Shin Asuka. Destiny, going in'; Setsuko/Garrod/Loran/Kamille addressed; the set also holds Rey (Legend cut-in, Gil), Lunamaria (Core Splendor cut-in, 'I am a Red Coat too') and Shinn-to-Luna lines (Sword Silhouette combo)

proposed_by_v_g142_00.basis: Self-intro 'Shin Asuka. Destiny, going in'; Setsuko/Garrod/Loran/Kamille addressed; the set also holds Rey (Legend cut-in, Gil), Lunamaria (Core Splendor cut-in, 'I am a Red Coat too') and Shinn-to-Luna lines (Sword Silhouette combo)

142:0.en: 「$$ギル$$... You'll lead the world, right...!」

142:37.en: 「$$レイ・ザ・バレル$$. Legend, launching!」

142:82.en: 「I can hit you even over there!」

142:142.en: 「If I have to fight, then I will!」

142:183.en: 「I won't give you time to counter!」

alternatives: This will be a direct hit!

142:410.en: 「I won't let you destroy our future!」

142:557.en: 「With this, I can take on anyone!」

142:783.en: 「$$デスティニー$$ can fight\nthis way too!」

142:941.en: 「I won't let this chance slip away!」

142:1049.en: 「$$カミーユ$$! I'll take it from here!」

142:1107.en: 「$$ロラン$$, leave the rest to me!」

142:1401.en: 「I'll show them what I can do!」

142:1420.en: 「If I can't act, why am I here...!」

142:1507.en: 「I won't let you do as you please!」

142:1680.en: 「You'll never keep up with $$デスティニー$$!」

alternatives: As if that could hurt me!

142:1799.en: 「So you'll resist to the very end?!」

142:2000.en: 「Damn it! Don't think this is over!」

142:2089.en: 「You dare, in a machine like that?!」

142:2262.en: 「Damn it! I can't take any more...!」

142:2457.en: 「$$シン・アスカ$$. $$デスティニー$$, launching!」

142:2552.en: 「All right, let's give it our all!」

142:2653.en: 「$$ルナマリア・ホーク$$. Core Splendor, go!」

142:2731.en: 「At this range, I can do it...!」

142:2760.en: 「$$デスティニー$$ and I can do this...!」

142:2851.en: 「I fight!\nTo guard all I hold dear!」

142:3012.en: 「$$ハマーン$$!\nYou call this battle just?!」

142:3067.en: 「I'll defeat you and end this war!」

142:3110.en: 「I'll stop you, $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

142:3149.en: 「You can never be the hope\nof the people in space!」

142:3740.en: 「I won't let your kind run wild!」

142:3855.en: 「We won't sit back and be destroyed!」
alternatives: We won't stand by and be destroyed!

142:3935.en: 「Damn you!\nNo god could be so evil!」

142:4328.en: 「I won't let you push Earth around!」

142:4371.en: 「$$セツコ$$ isn't the only one\nwho can't forgive you!」

142:4428.en: 「I'll settle the ties between us too!」

142:4465.en: 「Those people fought the $$スフィア$$s...!\nBut you!」

142:4522.en: 「You just drown in $$スフィア$$ power!」

142:4565.en: 「You who toy with hearts and fate...\nI'll take you down!」

142:4614.en: 「It's not you who decides fate!\nIt's us, ourselves!」

142:4856.en: 「If I can help even a little...!」

142:5214.en: 「$$カミーユ$$! I'll handle this one!」

142:5389.en: 「$$デスティニー$$ should be able to take it!」

142:5763.en: 「No...! This range puts me at risk!」

142:5993.en: 「Together is our only way to peace.」

142:6085.en: 「You and I go way back now.」

142:6147.en: 「Too soon. The fight isn't over yet.」

142:6208.en: 「Players, get a good rest too, okay?」

142:6266.en: 「D-Don't bring up the past! Let's greet the players together.」

142:6449.en: 「I can do it. I can, too!」

142:6587.en: 「You used to say 'Quit the game here? I...!'」

142:6968.en: 「I don't care what your ideals are!」

142:7248.en: 「If words won't get through to you!」

142:7396.en: 「Without a $$脳量子波$$ thing,\nmy voice can't reach you?!」

142:8068.en: 「$$刹那$$, I'll take it from here!」

142:8232.en: 「From here, it's my turn as planned!」

142:8386.en: 「$$フリーダム$$'s armor can't take that!」
